summary: Verified new region-scoped Transfer Proof upload feature. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_transfer_proof_region.py (13 new tests) — POST /api/admin/disbursements/transfer-proofs rejects with 400 before OCR when region is missing, empty, invalid ('Jawa Tengah'), or lowercase ('jakarta barat'); rejects 400 when region valid but stage invalid; rejects 400 when region valid but extension invalid (.txt); admin_wilayah receives 403 even with a valid region; and all six DKI regions (Jakarta Pusat/Utara/Barat/Selatan/Timur/Kepulauan Seribu) each progress past the region-guard into the file-validation step. Combined suite (test_campus_disbursements.py + test_beneficiary_pm.py + test_transfer_proof_region.py) = 71/71 green in ~16s. Frontend E2E (Admin Provinsi at 1440x900): [data-testid=transfer-proof-region-select] starts value='', contains empty placeholder + exactly 6 DKI region options, clicking [data-testid=upload-disbursement-proof-button] with no region selected triggers toast 'Pilih wilayah pencairan sebelum mengunggah bukti transfer.' (file picker does NOT open), selecting Jakarta Timur sets the select value correctly, mobile 390px scrollWidth-clientWidth=0px (no overflow). Cross-region resolve guard in resolve_beneficiary_review already covered by existing suite plus code review (line 2368: source.selected_region compared to profile_region -> 400).

issues: React hydration console warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. Caused by emergentagent visual-editor injecting <span data-ve-dynamic> attributes inside <option> children (see ReviewQueue recipient select and transfer-proof-region-select). Dev-only tooling, does not affect user flow but pollutes console. Consider suppressing x-* attribute injection on <option> children or using plain text nodes.

critical_code_review_comments: upload_disbursement_proofs stores selected_region correctly and matches beneficiaries via `item['region'] == region` (server.py line 2296). Good.

resolve_beneficiary_review guard (server.py 2367-2372): compares source.selected_region against profile_region(beneficiary['profile']). Only applied if source has selected_region — pre-region uploads (legacy) will pass through without regional check. Acceptable during migration but worth documenting.
Frontend transfer-proof-region-select has no id/label association (only data-testid). For accessibility, add <label htmlFor> or aria-label — screen readers currently read only the placeholder option.

The Gemini prompt includes 'KONTEKS WILAYAH UNGGAHAN' (server.py 2271-2273), which is good context injection. However, the AI is still authoritative on region — the deterministic filter `item['region'] == region` (line 2296) is what enforces the constraint. Prompt could be tightened to reduce token cost.

rca of the issue: Not applicable — no bugs discovered. Feature implementation matches all 9 requirements: dropdown starts blank & required, request payload carries `region`, backend 400 pre-OCR on missing/invalid region, source persists selected_region, matching filter restricts to same region, ReviewQueue carries selected_region, cross-region resolve rejected 400, admin_wilayah 403 preserved, mobile/desktop no overflow.
